sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint; nominal 27B language model, vision encoder, hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention layout, native 262144 context, text/image/video examples, optional thinking and tool calling. Reopened October 27: the language-model overview still gives 27B without a separate active count; the language and vision comparison tables contain benchmark scores, not activated-parameter columns.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with 64 dense text layers: three linear-attention layers per full-attention layer; intermediate_size 17408, no expert routing, vision configuration, one MTP layer and max_position_embeddings 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository created February 24, 2026; Apache-2.0 metadata; safetensors reports 27781419504 BF16 and 8448 F32 parameters, total 27781427952. Rechecked October 27 at repository revision fc05daec18b0a78c049392ed2e771dde82bdf654; safetensors.total remains 27781427952.

sources.title: Official Qwen series release timeline
sources.evidence: The official repository (formerly Qwen3.5) explicitly dates Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B release to 2026-02-24 and links the released weights.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index and referenced safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read the 11 indexed shard headers and summed all 1199 tensor shapes: language model including embeddings/output head 26895998464; vision 460730096; MTP 424699392. Sum 27781427952 matches repository metadata. Dense FFN tensor names confirm no expert tensors. October 27 recheck of the index confirms 1199 tensor entries across 11 shards; prior header-derived component counts are retained, without downloading shards in this pass.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B license
sources.evidence: Checkpoint license is Apache License, Version 2.0. Browser reader failed, but direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.6-27B developer comparison tables
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Both language and vision benchmark tables explicitly include Qwen3.5-27B, but neither provides total/activated-parameter rows or columns. The 27B model overview describes Qwen3.6 itself and is not a separate Qwen3.5 active-count disclosure.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.6-35B-A3B developer comparison tables
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Benchmarks explicitly include Qwen3.5-27B, without activated-parameter columns. The explicit 35B total / 3B activated specification applies to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B only.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.8-27B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 in the search for later developer count disclosures. No activated-parameter specification for Qwen3.5-27B appears.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud model release documentation
sources.evidence: The qwen3.5-27b row describes a 27B native vision-language dense model with linear attention. It supplies no separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: Official Qwen3.5 medium-size benchmark figure
sources.evidence: Official figure linked by the Qwen repository was fetched and visually inspected October 27. It shows benchmark bars and the Qwen3.5-27B label, without an activated-parameter value.

name.note: Display formatting of official Qwen3.5-27B name.

developer.note: Qwen is Alibaba Group’s model team.

release_date.note: Official timeline explicitly announces this open checkpoint on February 24; repository creation corroborates it. Correct the catalog’s February 23 date; no API-listing date is substituted.

open_weights.note: Public post-trained weights are provided in the official repository.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license and metadata agree.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint count including vision and MTP, preserved from the original tensor-shape audit and freshly reconfirmed by repository safetensors metadata. The card separately reports a nominal 27B language model; it does not replace the supported exact total.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh search of the exact card/configuration, later Qwen3.6/3.8 cards and comparison tables, Alibaba release documentation and the official benchmark figure found no separate developer active-count disclosure. Also checked the Qwen3.5-9B, 4B and 122B-A10B cards and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B card. Third-party 27B-active listings do not establish Qwen’s convention. Dense architecture alone does not justify equating active with the total or language-model count; vision and MTP participation varies by inference path.

architecture.note: Exact configuration and FFN tensors establish dense architecture with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full gated attention and a vision encoder. The card’s generic family-highlight MoE statement conflicts with its exact-model layout and must not classify this variant.

context_window.note: Native configured context; card separately documents extension to 1010000 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact checkpoint examples demonstrate all three inputs and generated text.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and may be disabled through enable_thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact serving commands enable tool calling; the card also provides Qwen-Agent usage.

patch.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 27.781427952B parameters, comprising 26.895998464B language model including embeddings/output head, 0.460730096B vision and 0.424699392B MTP. The card’s 27B is a nominal language-model count; a separate developer active count remains undisclosed. Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full attention; generic family MoE wording does not describe this checkpoint. Native context 262144; documented extension to 1010000.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the exact 27.781427952B checkpoint total and existing language/vision/MTP decomposition, reconfirmed against current metadata. Reopened primary sources and searched later developer comparison tables and figures; no separate Qwen active count was found, so explicitly retain null. Other audited corrections are unchanged.
